title: Dispatch Reference: Missed-Attempt Figures for Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
These are the waiting times, fees, miss limits and rebooking periods that apply to a missed attempt on a Delivery & Pickup Appointment, by fulfillment method.

## A. Waiting and customer-caused misses

| Fulfillment method | Wait past the window start before the attempt is missed for customer unavailability | Missed-appointment fee for a customer-unavailable miss | Customer-caused misses after which the appointment cannot be rebooked | Minimum calendar days from a customer-caused miss to the rebooked date | Days the vehicle stays held at the hub after a missed pickup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | 60 minutes | $0.00 | 2 | 1 | 5 |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | 30 minutes | $0.00 | 2 | 1 | 3 |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | 120 minutes | $0.00 | 1 | 3 | 5 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 20 minutes | $99.00 | 2 | 2 | 0 (not a pickup method) |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 20 minutes | $149.00 | 1 | 3 | 0 (not a pickup method) |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | 30 minutes | $249.00 | 1 | 5 | 0 (not a pickup method) |

## B. Kestrel-caused misses and delay

| Fulfillment method | Minutes after the window end beyond which a late Kestrel arrival counts as a Kestrel-caused miss if the customer declines to wait | Calendar days after a Kestrel-caused miss within which Kestrel must offer a rebooked date | Pending reschedule and missed-appointment fees waived after a Kestrel-caused miss | Calendar days Kestrel-caused rebooking may move the appointment past its original date before the buyer may cancel the order as vehicle unavailable |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | 0 minutes | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | 0 minutes | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | 0 minutes | 3 | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 60 minutes | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 60 minutes | 3 | Yes | 3 |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | 90 minutes | 5 | Yes | 3 |

## Notes

- A missed-appointment fee is charged only by the three delivered methods: $99.00 for Local Home Delivery, $149.00 for Extended-Zone Delivery and $249.00 for Enclosed White-Glove Delivery. The three pickup methods show $0.00.
- Under Fly & Drive, Extended-Zone Delivery and Enclosed White-Glove Delivery, the limit is reached at the first customer-caused miss (a limit of 1). Under the other three methods it is reached at the second (a limit of 2).
- The hub hold period applies to pickups. A figure of 0 marks a method that is not a pickup method.
- The late threshold for the pickup methods is 0 minutes, counted from the end of the window.
